articles.title: Show HN: Sokoban AI Solver
articles.summary: Sokoban Sokoban is a 1980s puzzle where the keeper must push boxes onto a goal while also finishing on the goal. The keeper can only move one square in any direction, and it cannot walk into a wall or a box. The puzzle has a grid layout, and the keeper can push a single box if the square just beyond the box is empty floor or a goal. The AI solver uses A* search to find the optimal solution, which involves exploring the board one step at a time and returning the fewest moves possible. The solver is efficient, using a compact bitmask state and a deadlock-prone-freeze check to guide the search.
